lines.trans: I can shop all day, yet the gossip you shared today was truly explosive, Chairwoman.
It is enough to make me see you in a whole new light.
With high praise like that from you, should I feel thrilled or tearful?
Chairwoman, you even know that I joined Xingtian out of admiration for Mr Chun Yuqiao?
Truth be told, ever since my undergraduate days I have seen Mr Chun Yuqiao as my idol.
He always has been—my one and only idol.
After joining Xingtian and meeting him in person, he turned out different from what I imagined.
In fact, it made me find him even more remarkable.
Next to my parents, he is the person who has influenced me most deeply.
Chairwoman, it is really simple—put courage and youth together and you get one word: foolish!
